title: alnus multinervis
intro: Alnus multinervis, commonly known as Green Alder, is a species of tree in the alder family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Alnus multinervis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities. The therapeutic actions of Alnus multinervis also include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and exhibit anti-cancer properties.
